summary: Frontend-only test of CFO Control Tower, the quote editor (IVA selector, lead time, discount up to 40%, Competitor Analyzer, email dialog/blockers, email card), commercial-role restrictions and Email settings 'Mittente tenant'. CRITICAL: /cfo crashed on every load with 'ReferenceError: Cannot access legalEntityFilter before initialization' (TDZ). I applied a minimal fix (moved one line) to unblock testing, so the main agent must review it. After the fix, all requested flows pass. One minor bug: the QUOTE_SENT email body renders a literal 'None' when no custom message is given.

minor.issue: With no custom message, ctx['message']=None. Jinja `default()` only replaces UNDEFINED values, not None, so the email preview body (and the real sent email) shows a literal 'None' line instead of 'Restiamo a disposizione per qualsiasi chiarimento.'. Fix: omit the key when message is empty, or use `{{ message | default('...', true) }}`.

ui_bugs.issue: Page crashed on mount: the useEffect at line 38 referenced legalEntityFilter before its useState declaration (line 40), causing a TDZ ReferenceError and a red runtime overlay. FIXED by the testing agent by moving the useEffect below the useState declarations.

rca of the issue: CFO crash: a recent edit inserted `useEffect(... legalEntityFilter ...)` before `const [legalEntityFilter] = useState('all')`. During render, the effect's deps array is evaluated immediately, so it hit the TDZ and threw a ReferenceError. Mitigation: move the effect after the declaration (done). Email 'None': Python None is passed into the Jinja context and the `default` filter without boolean=true does not replace None.
